skill.name: claude-plugin
skill.description: Adds Claude Code context tools for repo-map symbol search, file symbol lookup, repository indexing, and local project context files.
skill.summary: Search and inspect repository symbols through local repo-map MCP tools.
skill.author: ChipFlow

security_audit.summary: Most static command and network findings are false positives from Markdown examples or repository metadata. The confirmed risk is local project access: the plugin starts a repo-map MCP server, indexes the active project, and stores symbol metadata in hidden .claude files. I found no evidence of prompt injection or remote data exfiltration in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The plugin launches a local MCP server with access to the current project.
remediation.suggestion: Show a clear install-time warning, require user confirmation before first indexing, and document the exact command and project scope.

remediation.issue: Hidden .claude repo-map files can contain source metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Document stored fields, retention behavior, cleanup steps, and exclude patterns for sensitive paths.

remediation.issue: The referenced MCP server implementation is outside the reviewed three-file package.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the server source with the plugin package or pin an auditable version before marketplace approval.

content.value_statement: Large repositories make symbol lookup slow and repetitive. This skill adds repo-map MCP tools that index project symbols and retrieve relevant code context quickly.
actual_capabilities: Searches functions, classes, and methods by symbol name pattern through repo-map MCP tools.
Lists indexed symbols for a selected file.
Retrieves source content for an indexed symbol by exact name.
Refreshes the repository symbol map and reports indexing status.
Waits for background indexing and reports stale or failed indexes.
Uses per-project .claude repo-map files when switching working directories.
limitations: Requires Claude Code plugin installation and a session restart before MCP tools are available.
Symbol indexing is documented for Python, C++, and Rust.
It does not replace full-text search for comments, strings, or unsupported languages.
It creates local .claude index, manifest, learning, and log files inside projects.

use_cases.title: Find symbol definitions quickly
use_cases.description: Locate functions, classes, and methods by name pattern before reading full files.

use_cases.title: Review large repositories
use_cases.description: Build a fast map of important symbols and files before reviewing a change.

use_cases.title: Prepare safer refactors
use_cases.description: Refresh the symbol index and compare related definitions before moving or rewriting code.

prompt_templates.title: Find a symbol pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the repo-map tools to search for symbols matching parse_* and summarize the best matches.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one file
prompt_templates.prompt: List the symbols in src/models/user.py, then identify which classes or functions I should inspect first.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a feature entry point
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for handler symbols related to billing, fetch the most relevant symbol content, and explain the control flow.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh before refactoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Check repo-map status, reindex if stale, wait for completion, and compare overlapping symbols before I refactor.

output_examples.input: Search for parse functions in the repository.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of matching symbols with file paths, line numbers, and guidance on which results matter.

output_examples.input: Show me symbols in the authentication module.
output_examples.output: A concise inventory of classes, functions, and methods found in the selected file.

output_examples.input: Reindex the repo map and report status.
output_examples.output: A status summary showing whether indexing completed, failed, or needs another retry.

best_practices: Restart Claude Code after installing or updating the plugin.
Use symbol search for names and standard search for file content.
Review .claude artifacts before sharing a project archive.
anti_patterns: Do not assume unsupported languages are fully indexed.
Do not rely on stale repo-map results after large code changes.
Do not index repositories with secrets without checking local storage policy.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps Claude Code search and inspect repository symbols through local repo-map MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it send my code to a remote service?
faq.answer: No evidence in the reviewed files shows remote code upload. The documented behavior uses local MCP tools and project files.

faq.question: Which languages are indexed?
faq.answer: The skill documents symbol indexing for Python, C++, and Rust.

faq.question: Why do I need to restart Claude Code?
faq.answer: MCP servers start with Claude Code, so a restart loads the plugin server configuration.

faq.question: Does it replace Grep or Read?
faq.answer: No. Use repo-map tools for symbol names, and use standard tools for full file content or text search.

faq.question: What local files can it create?
faq.answer: It can use .claude project manifest, repo-map markdown, repo-map database, learnings, and log files.
